start: Today screen, owner, online, real gym with the assistant on

user_sees: Card 'AI Assistant' with a credits pill
A box that reads 'Ask or give a task, in Hindi or English'
'{n} ideas for today' (or '1 idea for today') with at most two ideas, each naming who it is about, with 'See who' and an action button
must_not: More than two ideas
The card pushed wider than the phone
An idea about a member who is no longer there

user_sees: On a phone the AI Assistant screen opens; on a computer the side panel opens
The ask box is empty and ready
must_not: Anything asked by itself
A credit taken

steps.action: Type a request and tap send
user_sees: A bubble, Thinking…, then a card
must_not: The request lost

start: Today screen with at least one idea

user_sees: The assistant opens with the idea already asked: a bubble and Thinking…
Then a draft to check
must_not: A message sent without the owner checking it
A credit taken before he taps send on the draft
The idea asked twice

start: Today screen with an idea that has a list behind it

user_sees: The assistant opens with the idea as a bubble and the list of members under it, at once
must_not: Thinking…
A question counted or a credit taken
A member on the list who does not fit the idea
Someone who joined today counted as not seen

steps.action: Turn the internet off and tap See who again
user_sees: The list still shows
must_not: An error for a list the app already has

steps.action: Tap the credits pill on the card
user_sees: The assistant opens
must_not: A dead tap
A pill whose spoken label promises the credits sheet while a different screen opens

start: Today screen as staff, trainer, the demo gym, or an owner whose server has no assistant

user_sees: No AI Assistant card; the rest of Today as usual
must_not: The AI Assistant shown to staff, a trainer, the demo gym or an owner who is offline
An empty gap where the card would be
The card flashing up before the server has answered

start: Today screen; today's free questions are used up

user_sees: The assistant opens with the box saying 'No more free questions today. Ask again tomorrow.'
must_not: The idea dropped with no word at all
The idea sent past the limit

start: Today screen showing an idea to wish a member

steps.action: Tap the action, send the drafted message, go back to Today
user_sees: The pill is 1 lower
The idea is gone or no longer names that member
must_not: The same idea asking to message the same member again
The old balance on the pill

steps.action: Turn the automatic birthday wish on in settings, open Today
user_sees: Only members who will not get the automatic wish are named
must_not: A member wished twice

steps.action: Open Today on a day with no ideas
user_sees: The card with the box only
must_not: '0 ideas for today'

start: Today screen on a shared desk computer

user_sees: Names of this gym's members and why (for example 'no visit in 12 days')
must_not: Another gym's members
Money totals in an idea for a login that may not see totals

steps.action: Sign out; sign in as staff
user_sees: No AI card and no ideas
must_not: The owner's ideas or balance left on screen for staff

steps.action: Tap an idea's action as owner
user_sees: Only then are the request words sent to the AI
must_not: Member names sent to the AI just by opening Today
